issues.description: In Exercise 4.2 (Lights Out), the template defines `GroverLightsOutPuzzle.state_preparation(qc, switch_register, tile_register, auxiliary_register, state_of_lights)`, but the problem statement and the rest of the class refer to this register as `flip_register` (the register representing which switches to flip). This naming inconsistency can confuse learners when wiring registers between methods and when following the written instructions that repeatedly mention `flip_register`.
issues.suggestedFix: In the template, rename the `state_preparation` parameter `switch_register` to `flip_register`, and update the docstring argument name accordingly so it matches the problem statement and other methods.

issues.description: Exercises 2.6, 4.6, and 5.6 require returning measurement counts, but the solution code uses `Aer.get_backend("statevector_simulator")` and then calls `result.get_counts(qc)`. Counts are expected from shot-based measurement simulation (qasm-style backends), while a statevector backend is intended to return amplitudes/statevectors. This mismatch can mislead students about the correct simulator backend to use for counts-based tasks and may fail depending on backend behavior.
issues.suggestedFix: For counts-returning exercises (2.6/4.6/5.6), switch the solution (and any template guidance) to a shot-based backend such as `Aer.get_backend("qasm_simulator")` or `AerSimulator()` and keep `statevector_simulator` only for the statevector task (Exercise 1.6).
